sentences.text: The sign that shows how others see brothers, sisters and courage, Libra, leans unfavourably: the Moon sits there, with no helpful planet beside.

notes.text: against — more malefics than benefics occupy A3: the vote is against
arudha (the image of a house) A3: Libra, 6th from the lagna; occupants Moon; benefics none.

shown: Let me go through the areas you asked about.
For your father, the house of fortune and fathers, the 9th house, sits in Capricorn and is among the least supported of your twelve houses.
The planets that signify your father lean unfavourably; the Sun, one of them, sits in Aquarius in your 10th house, in an unfriendly sign.
The divisional chart for your father leans unfavourably; there Mars falls in Gemini, in an unfriendly sign.
Taken together, the houses that govern your reputation lean unfavourably, and the main one, the 10th house from your rising sign, in Aquarius, is the one that lacks support.
The Sun, the main planet that stands for reputation, sits in that same house in an unfriendly sign.
Libra, which shows how the matters of your 10th house appear to others, holds the Moon with no helpful planet beside it.
For brothers, sisters and courage, the Moon rules the 3rd house but sits in Libra in your 6th house, in a neutral sign.
In the divisional chart for this area, the Sun falls in Libra, where it is debilitated and least at ease.
Libra, the sign that shows how others see your brothers and sisters, holds the Moon with no helpful planet beside it.
